profile.name: Meet Modasiya
profile.tagline: A React Developer building the frontend, exploring the dark arts of backend because sleep is optional anyway.
profile.about_text:
Sup! I’m a React Developer who enjoys turning complex problems into clean, functional, and user-friendly web experiences. I build real-world applications that don’t just look good they work well in production too.

I’m probably not the kind of developer who lives only inside backend architecture diagrams. You’ll usually find me crafting interfaces in React, refining layouts, improving performance, and making sure every interaction feels smooth and natural. That said, I’m actively exploring the backend world building APIs, designing databases, and slowly unlocking the dark arts of full-stack development.

I’ve worked on live client projects including production e-commerce platforms and business systems, which taught me that a great website is more than just design. It must be fast, reliable, and easy to use. My experience across frontend, backend-in-progress, and real deployments allows me to build digital products that balance clean UI with solid engineering and I’m always hungry to learn more and build better.
